playbook.title: Weekly Invoice Reconciliation
playbook.objective: Match incoming vendor invoices against purchase orders and flag mismatches before payment is approved.

steps.name: Download vendor invoices
steps.description: Log into the vendor portal and download all invoices issued in the last 7 days.
steps.notes: Some vendors email invoices instead of posting to the portal.

steps.name: Match invoices to purchase orders
steps.description: For each invoice, look up the matching PO number in the ERP system and compare line items.
steps.notes: Mismatches over $50 must be escalated to the purchasing manager.
